• Coffee producer plots in Cauca, Huila, Tolima
• LoRaWAN gateways & cellular telemetry stations
Telemetry Payload

Security & Transport
• MQTT over TLS 1.3 with X.509 device certificates
• 15-minute periodic heartbeat & batch telemetry

div.div:
Message Broker & Ingress
• Mutual TLS authentication via AWS IoT Core
• Topic: aroma/{farm_id}/telemetry
IoT Topic Rule [D09]
• SQL query: SELECT * FROM 'aroma/+/telemetry'
• Direct PutItem action into Amazon DynamoDB
• Zero compute overhead: eliminates Lambda hop
Failure Path
• Error action dispatches corrupt payload to SQS DLQ

Storage Architecture
• Table: aroma-telemetry-{env}
• Partition Key: farm_id#sensor_id (String)
• Sort Key: timestamp (ISO-8601 String)
Security & Change Stream
• KMS CMK encryption at rest with annual rotation
• DynamoDB Streams enabled: NEW_IMAGE capture
• Sub-millisecond write latency for high volume feeds

• Batch size: 100 records with 5s batch window

• Severe soil moisture deficit & flood warning
• Windowed deduplication suppresses duplicate alerts
Canary Rollout Policy [D11]
• Deployed via CodeDeploy canary traffic shift

div.div:
IoT Core Error Action: Invalid MQTT payload or unparseable JSON routed to SQS DLQ aroma-iot-dlq (zero silent message drops).
Lambda Stream Failure: On-failure destination routes poison pills to SQS DLQ after 3 retries with BisectBatchOnFunctionError enabled.
CloudWatch Alarms: TelemetryDLQMessagesVisible > 0 alerts DevOps on-call; SensorSilent > 60m flags hardware disconnection.

div.div:
Object Storage Target [D04]
• Bucket: aroma-drone-objects-{env}
• Direct upload via time-limited Pre-signed URL
• Tier: object_storage / application endpoint
Integrity & Encryption
• S3 PutObject verifies SHA-256 header digest
• Server-Side Encryption with AWS KMS CMK (D03)
• Lifecycle: Transitions raw TIFFs to Glacier after 90d
Event Generation
• Emits s3:ObjectCreated:* on successful upload

Metadata & Raster Screening
• Validates TIFF header structure and GeoTIFF tags
• Verifies flight boundary coordinates against plot GPS
Mission State Persistence
• Creates mission record in DynamoDB missions table
• Status: RECEIVED with metadata and timestamp
EventBridge Pipeline Integration
• Emits MissionValidated event to EventBridge bus
• Quarantines corrupted files to S3 quarantine/

• Amazon Bedrock Foundation Model (Claude 3.5 Sonnet / Vision)
• Multispectral canopy stress & chlorophyll analysis
Disease & Anomaly Detection
• Coffee leaf rust (Hemileia vastatrix) lesion scoring
• Outputs GeoJSON heatmaps with georeferenced bounding boxes
Inference Storage
• Output stored in S3 processed-analysis/ and DynamoDB

Traceability & Federation Audit

div.div: Flight-Object Failure Handling, Quarantine & Dead-Letter Queues

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 1968px; height: 1px; padding-top: 1282px; margin-left: 583px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #7f1d1d;
display: inline-block; font-size: 13px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#7f1d1d, #ffb0b0); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
S3 Integrity Failure: SHA-256 mismatch or truncated upload causes immediate HTTP 400 rejection; mobile app notifies pilot to re-upload.
Quarantine Storage: Corrupt GeoTIFF rasters or out-of-boundary flight coordinates moved to S3 quarantine/ prefix for forensic analysis.
Dead-Letter Queue: Unhandled screening or Bedrock invocation timeouts routed to SQS DLQ aroma-drone-reception-dlq with CloudWatch Alarm.
Agronomist Re-Scan Notice: Pilot dashboard updated with failure reason (e.g., lens occlusion, excessive cloud shadow, corrupted band).
